n1.speaker: nadia
n1.text:
Well. The harbor crew.
Heard you rang three on poor Salt.

n2.speaker: nadia
n2.text:
Here's Spicegate math: cage time costs stall time.
Nobody plays the Kettle for free.

n4.speaker: nadia
n4.text:
Seppi's short-handed and loud about it.
Move a crate for him, and we'll talk.

n5.speaker: nadia
n5.text:
Harbor crew, hm. You've got HER—
...you've got nerve. I'll say that.

s1.speaker: seppi
s1.text:
You're the crate crew? Good. Spices for Nadia.
Drop it and she owes ME for once.

s2.speaker: seppi
s2.text:
Careful with her, harbor kid. That stall ledger of hers
goes back a hundred years. Debts outlive everybody.

w1.speaker: nadia
w1.text: Seppi's stall is the loud one. Follow the complaining.

d1.speaker: nadia
d1.text:
Ha! He actually paid his tab in cargo. A first.
Fine — the Kettle will hear your challenge.

d2.speaker: nadia
d2.text:
One thing. Your winger — Juno.
She ran deliveries for my crew, before your harbor took her back.

d3.speaker: nadia
d3.text:
She'll want to beat us ALONE.
Sort her head out first, or the Kettle will do it for you.

j1.speaker: juno
j1.text:
so. yes. i ran crates for the Runners.
they called me delivery girl. for TWO YEARS, Ash.

j2.speaker: juno
j2.text:
not runner. not winger. DELIVERY GIRL.
i want to beat them so bad my teeth hurt.

choices.text: WE show them. All of us.

j4a.speaker: juno
j4a.text:
...yeah. YEAH.
feed me the ball and stay out of the blast radius.

j4b.speaker: juno
j4b.text:
...okay. okay okay okay.
all of us. but i get the LAST bell. deal?

j5.speaker: juno
j5.text:
(she's already jogging to the Kettle)
CAGE. NOW.

p1.speaker: nadia
p1.text:
Kettle rules: first to three bells, walls in play.
Debts get settled in the cage.

p2.speaker: nadia
p2.text:
Oh — and delivery girl?
Try to keep up with the REAL runners.

p3.speaker: juno
p3.text:
(quietly, to no one)
last bell's mine.

r1.speaker: nadia
r1.text:
That's the Kettle, harbor crew.
It boils everyone the first time.

r2.speaker: juno
r2.text:
they pass FAST but they pass PREDICTABLE.
cut the lanes. trust me. again. AGAIN.

a1.speaker: nadia
a1.text:
...Ha. HA! Did you see that?
Spicegate, did you SEE that?!

a2.speaker: nadia
a2.text:
The pin's yours — and so is my sponsorship.
Your travel runs on Spicegate coin now. Call it an investment.

a3.speaker: juno
a3.text:
...they clapped.
did you hear? they CLAPPED. for ME.

a4.speaker: nadia
a4.text:
Of course they did, runner.
That's what you always were.

a5.speaker: system
a5.text:
PIN EARNED — THE SPICE RUNNERS
Old Cobble waits up the hill. (Arrives in the next build.)

h1.speaker: nadia
h1.text:
My sponsorship money says the Saints will bore you
to death before they beat you. Prove me right.

h1.speaker: seppi
h1.text:
Crate crew! My best customer!
Technically my only unpaid one, but STILL.

h1.speaker: juno
h1.text:
i keep walking past my old stall like it's nothing.
it's not nothing. but it's getting smaller.

b1.speaker: system
b1.text:
Nadia's stall ledger — older than the awnings.
Debts a century deep, in a dozen different hands.

b2.speaker: system
b2.text:
One line, crossed out so hard the page tore:
"S.M. — PAID IN FULL. FOREVER."
